condition: Proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC under REQ-0009.
event: The final bid document exceeds 20 pages or portal congestion delays the upload past 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
effect: The bid is disqualified immediately without evaluation.
assumptions: The formatting can be condensed into 20 pages without losing required content.
trigger: The draft bid exceeds 18 pages one week before submission.
responses: Enforce a strict 18-page budget for all sections immediately.
Upload the PDF 24 hours before the deadline.
residual_exposure: A technical outage of the procurement portal on the final day.

condition: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11 for spring enrollment under REQ-0023, leaving only 41 calendar days from the proposal deadline of 2026-12-01.
event: Integration with the student records system REST API or environment setup experiences delays during the winter break.
effect: Students cannot sign documents when spring enrollment opens, breaching the go-live requirement.
assumptions: The College's REST API documentation is complete and accessible immediately upon contract award.
trigger: API integration testing is not completed by 2026-12-20.
responses: Begin mock API integration prior to formal contract award.
Negotiate a staged rollout prioritizing critical enrollment forms first.
residual_exposure: Limited time to resolve edge cases discovered during live student usage.
